adversarial_findings.finding: The ontology lists LTF/HTF durations but does not yet freeze canonical bar anchoring/phase for every timeframe. Multi-timeframe state can differ if bars are phase-shifted.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Freeze bars from canonical quote timestamps with one deterministic anchor convention per dataset; no session-relative re-anchoring during mining.

adversarial_findings.finding: Public seed uses a single close series, while QROS canonical data contains Bid/Ask. Feature price source must be frozen separately from execution side.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Enumerate causal feature sources BID and MID as preregistered interpretations; ASK-only is redundant unless independently justified. Execution remains Bid/Ask-specific.

adversarial_findings.finding: EMA values depend on initialization at the start of the available sample.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Require a deterministic pre-development warmup where available and exclude at least 10 times the largest active EMA period after a hard dataset boundary before signals are eligible.

adversarial_findings.finding: Data authority preserves crossed and zero-spread states, but feature-bar construction policy is not explicit.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Preserve quote chronology; crossed quotes cannot create fills. Zero-spread states cannot create artificial fills. Feature bars must use the frozen causal source and document whether invalid quote states are included or excluded consistently.

adversarial_findings.finding: Session filters are not causal-stable until broker/server timezone and DST are demonstrated.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Keep ALL-session baseline always eligible; named sessions remain disabled for economic mining until timezone/DST mapping is proven from data authority.

adversarial_findings.finding: The ontology freezes first signal per bar but not one-active-position-per-asset interaction during module research.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Primary module simulation permits at most one active position per asset and rejects overlapping entries until the prior trade exits. Portfolio max-three-new-entries/day is evaluated separately after module eligibility.

adversarial_findings.finding: Some listed HTF/LTF pairs are duration-ordered but not integer multiples, which can create ambiguous aggregation lineage.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Require HTF duration to be an integer multiple of LTF duration for the initial frozen ontology; noninteger relations require a separate descendant with explicit tick-level aggregation.

adversarial_findings.finding: NO_EXTRA_CONFIRMATION and confirmation_window=0 overlap with touch/reclaim definitions and may duplicate masks.
adversarial_findings.required_fix: Apply structural dedupe before scoring and record identical masks as aliases, not independent tests.
